art_direction: 柔奶黄底水青双眼，右侧下弧更饱满，柔和右望。
composition_variation: Give the right bowl a fuller lower curve and a slightly higher center; the left opening stays eighteen percent shallower. Both upper lids bow softly with moderate thickness and unbroken curved edges. The large flat black pupils connect to the lids and share a subtle rightward gaze. Use matching aqua lower bands with short tapered ends and one narrow elongated ivory glint per pupil. The quiet pastel background must be visibly colored rather than almost white, matching the exact palette below; retain a soft, low-saturation paper color across the entire square. No background gradients or decorations.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
